decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the propsals would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the wider area and would not cause harm to neighbour's living conditions in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residentail Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension and garge hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenities of the neighbouring residential property against increased overlooking with resultant loss of privacy)

Condition : 5 - The approved garage shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the existing dwelling on the site and shall not be used as separate living accommodation or for business purposes.

REASON:  To protect neighbouring residents' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and detached single storey garage/gym building to side of house.
